mapper.insert: INSERT INTO alert_log (event_id, customer_id, car_id, car_num, alert_type) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{customerId}, #{carId}, #{carNum}, #{alertType})
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.event_id, ue.underpass_id, a.customer_id, a.car_id, a.car_num, a.alert_type, a.sent_at FROM alert_log a JOIN underpass_event ue ON ue.id = a.event_id
ORDER BY a.sent_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alert_log a JOIN underpass_event ue ON ue.id = a.event_id

SELECT a.id, u.name AS underpass_name, a.car_num, c.phone AS recipient_phone, a.alert_type, a.sent_at FROM alert_log a JOIN underpass_event ue ON ue.id = a.event_id JOIN underpass u ON u.id = ue.underpass_id JOIN customer c ON c.id = a.customer_id
ORDER BY a.sent_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alert_log a JOIN underpass_event ue ON ue.id = a.event_id JOIN underpass u ON u.id = ue.underpass_id
